fusions.name: Flat-Out Lance
fusions.desc: A steam-driven lance thrust at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.8 times at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Camshaft Charge
fusions.desc: Pistoned hooves hammer the ground around you, which deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Throttle Open
fusions.desc: Opens the throttle wide: your movement speed rises by 35% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Governor
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover spins up a governor: your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
